description_en: Updates the zones of a Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance
description_zh: 更新负载均衡实例可用区
kebab_example: aliyun gwlb update-load-balancer-zones --load-balancer-id gwlb-9njtjmqt7zfcqm0000 --zone-mappings ZoneId=cn-hangzhou-h VSwitchId=vsw-bp1n75pbs77v5q6p30000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateLoadBalancerZones

parameters.help_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例的ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

fields.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch in the zone. You can specify only one vSwitch (subnet) in each zone of a GWLB instance
fields.help_zh: 可用区对应的交换机，每个可用区只能使用一台交换机和一个子网
fields.name: vswitch_id

fields.help_en: The zone ID. You can call the DescribeZones operation to query the most recent zone list
fields.help_zh: 可用区ID，通过调用网关型负载均衡DescribeZones接口获得
fields.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The mappings between zones and vSwitches. You must specify at least one zone. You can specify at most 20 zones. If the region supports two or more zones, we recommend that you select two or more zones
parameters.help_zh: 可用区及交换机映射列表。至少需要添加一个可用区，最多支持添加20个可用区。若当前地域支持2个及以上的可用区，建议添加2个及以上可用区
parameters.name: zone_mappings

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run, without performing the actual request. Valid values:

true: performs only a dry run. The system checks the request for potential issues, including missing parameter values, incorrect request syntax, and service limits. If the request fails the dry run, an error code is returned. If the request passes the dry run, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and performs the actual request. If the request passes the dry run, a 2xx HTTP status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更新实例可用区。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the request ID as the client token. The request ID may be different for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token
